newsitem.title: CHINA: China school collapses, 36 children injured.
newsitem.headline: China school collapses, 36 children injured.

text.p: A school building collapsed in southern China, injuring 36 children, including 12 who were being treated in hospital, local officials said on Friday.
The roof of the Xizhou primary school in Qingyuan in southern Guandong province collapsed on Wednesday morning, shortly after the children began classses, state television said.
Local officials said 36 children were injured, including 12 who were still in hospital and expected to be released shortly.
The cause of the collapse was under investigation but state television said the building was old and the structure could have been weakened by a recent typhoon and severe hailstorms.
China has reported the collapse of several school buildings in recent years, including some in which many children have been killed.
State media said this week that China's construction industry was riddled with corruption and this had led to shoddy quality and fatal building collapses.
Some 27.6 percent of economic crimes in China in 1996 involved the construction industry, figures compiled by the Supreme People's Procuratorate showed.

About 20 people were killed and more than 40 injured when a factory dormitory in southeastern Fujian province collapsed last month. Officials said that disaster may have been caused by structural defects.
